select SUBSCRIPTION_ID SUBSCRIPTION_ID2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT SUBSCRIPTION_ID SUBSCRIPTION_ID2, * FROM
EDS.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION  WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_ID='1085635027' and BASE_NO='ed87ced4a100e6425e7dc1ff9387ed4d'
UNION ALL
SELECT SUBSCRIPTION_ID SUBSCRIPTION_ID2, * FROM
EDS.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION  WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_ID='1083087290' and BASE_NO='852228c3fce2e609ac4bd0ef9b22e172'
UNION ALL
SELECT SUBSCRIPTION_ID SUBSCRIPTION_ID2, * FROM
EDS.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION  WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_ID='1068896782' and BASE_NO='9c0d0e953acc559ca983cf5737c4b0d7'
UNION ALL
SELECT SUBSCRIPTION_ID SUBSCRIPTION_ID2, * FROM
EDS.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION  WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_ID='9999' and BASE_NO='9999' ) temp order by SUBSCRIPTION_ID, SCD_START_DATE
